create_schedulefree_wrapper: create a ScheduleFreeWrapperReference optimizer wrapping a base PyTorch optimizer with momentum and weight decay
train_schedulefree_model: train a model using ScheduleFreeWrapperReference by calling train, stepping with a loss closure, and updating parameters
eval_schedulefree_model: evaluate a model using ScheduleFreeWrapperReference by switching to eval mode and restoring averaged parameters
save_schedulefree_state: save the optimizer state of a ScheduleFreeWrapperReference using state_dict for checkpointing and resuming training
resume_schedulefree_training: resume training with ScheduleFreeWrapperReference by loading a saved state_dict and switching back to train mode
